whenToUse: When customers or stakeholders are to be surveyed in writing: design the questionnaire, send it as an HTML file per recipient, read in the answer files and evaluate them — without a server, the data stays in the project.

columns.respondent: Who answered: the recipient, anonymous or without recipient.
columns.sentAt: When the file for the recipient was made and with which version of the questionnaire.
columns.sent: How many recipients got their file.
columns.rate: Response rate: answered divided by sent.
columns.n: How many responses count for the row.
columns.dist: How often each level from 1 to 5 was chosen.
columns.na: How often no answer was chosen.
columns.category: The Kano category of the row, determined from the answer pairs.
columns.better: Satisfaction coefficient: how much the feature delights when present, from 0 to 1.
columns.worse: Dissatisfaction coefficient: how much its absence annoys; the larger the magnitude, the stronger.
columns.share: Its share of the responses to the question.

name: Survey builder
description: Create VoC questionnaires, send them as HTML, import and evaluate the answers
fieldAnonymous: Evaluate anonymously (no names in the results)
confirmDeleteAffected: {count} imported responses contain answers to this. Delete anyway? Those answers will drop out of the results.
confirmChangeType: {count} imported responses contain answers to this question. Changing the type loses its entries and the link to those answers. Continue?
conditionsRemoved: Conditions removed: {count} (their source question is gone or no longer comes first).
propertiesEmpty: Select a section or question to edit it.
conditionsNone: No earlier choice question – conditions need a single or multiple choice question before this one.
conditionsHint: Show when any of these conditions holds:
warnNoQuestions: The questionnaire has no question yet.
previewHint: This is how the questionnaire looks. You can click through the conditions here; nothing is saved.
versionNext: Version {version} – the next export will be version {next}
recipientsEmpty: No recipients yet. Every recipient gets a file of their own – that is how you see who has answered.
anonymousInfo: This questionnaire is evaluated anonymously: the list only tracks the response rate, names do not appear in the results.
confirmRecipientDelete: “{name}” has already answered. Delete anyway? The response stays, without a recipient.
importHint: Pick answer files (.json) or drop them here – several at once are fine.
importInvalid: not a valid answer file – rejected
importUnknownRecipient: recipient no longer in the list – imported without recipient
importOrphans: {count} answers no longer match a question and were dropped
confirmResponseDelete: Delete this response? It will no longer count in the results.
previewFailed: The preview could not be built.
reportExportFailed: The report could not be exported.
vocTakenMark: already added to the VoC tree
kanoHandedOver: Kano question handed over to the Kano module

runner.noscript: This questionnaire needs JavaScript. Please open the file in a current browser.
runner.kanoImportance: How important is it to you?
runner.resetConfirm: Delete all answers and start over?
runner.draftOutdated: This questionnaire has changed since you started filling it in. Your previous answers have been kept – please check them.
runner.saved: The file “{file}” has been saved. Please send it back to the contact person.

report.freeText: {total} open answers, {taken} taken into the VoC tree

invariants.uniqueIds: Each id of a section, question, option, row, recipient and response occurs only once.
invariants.questionShape: A question carries exactly the keys of its type: options and Other for choice questions, rows and no answer for ratings, rows and importance for Kano questions, multiline for free text.
invariants.validConditions: A condition points to an earlier single or multiple choice and names at least one of its options.
invariants.validUi: The filter of the results names an existing question, the grouping an existing single choice question.
invariants.validSelection: The selected question must occur in the questionnaire; otherwise none is selected.
invariants.answeredRecipients: Only existing recipients count as answered.

confirmRecipientDeleteUnnamed: “(no name)” has already answered. Delete anyway? The response stays, without a recipient.
handoverFailed: The hand-over failed. Nothing was changed.

kano.scale5: I would dislike it a lot
